Name: Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats - New Custom NPCs
Author: tiakall
Description:
Official Merchandise* for Jorts and Jean! The cats of [url=https://www.cnet.com/how-to/jorts-the-cat-everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-internets-new-favourite-cat/]viral internet fame[/url] have come to Stardew Valley! They are giftable, friendable, have a plethora of things to say, cross-compatible with many other custom NPCs, and feature two events tied to the Reddit AITA post that started it all. If you follow JortsTheCat on Twitter, you'll also probably see some familiar lines too.  They will first start roaming after the Joja landslide is cleared but can be added to an in-progress game at any time.

[b]UPDATE 1.1[/b]: Bugfixes + one new event + optional tweaks to two vanilla events!

[b]UPDATE 1.2[/b]: Resort time! Jorts and Jean can now visit the Ginger Island resort if you have atravita's excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10004]Ginger Island Mainland Adjustments[/url] installed. It makes sure that the cats will visit the resort together (because Jorts should not be left on a scrungy island unattended) and gives them the option to explore the northern part of the island, with lots of new dialogue!  Also included: A new event with Vincent, and bugfixes/tweaks!  1.2.1 fixes a bug in the Linus event that freezes the event, despite the fact that it most certainly did *not* freeze during testing. Sigh.

[b]UPDATE 1.3[/b]: Lots of new additions!  Jorts and Jean can now go to the movies, Ridgeside, and have three new events!  Plus a ton of additional compatibility with things like Mobile Phone and Wildflour's mods!  New special order with East Scarp!

[b]UPDATE 1.4[/b]: More like 1.6, amirite?  Jorts and Jean are now fully working in 1.6 (or at least, they'd better be.)  [b]This update will not work in 1.5. Please do not try. [/b]Planned additional content for Sunberry and Biscuit crossovers and a new event Soon (tm).

[b]UPDATE 1.5[/b]:  New i18n conversion! New event with Shane and Jean! New special order for Ridgeside! New event for Sunberry! New compatibility with They Deserve it Too!  New bugfixes for old problems!  New I am tired of bugs and going to go take a nap.

[center][b]EVENTS[/b][/center]
[spoiler]
Intro event: Enter town during the day after the landslide is removed.
Second event: When Jorts and Jean are both at four hearts, enter town between 4PM and midnight.
Side event: Year 2, enter town on Sunday between 6PM and midnight.
Side event: Three hearts with Jorts and Vincent, enter the town between 8AM and 6PM.
Side event: Jorts at eight hearts, enter the mountain after 8PM.
Union event 1: One heart with Jorts and Jean, enter town during the day.  If the CC is complete it will be presented as a flashback.
Union event 2: Six hearts with Jorts and Jean, have seen Shane's cliffside event, enter town during the day.  If the theater is already complete it will be presented as a flashback.
Union event inbetween: Have eight hearts with Jorts and Jean, have seen Shane's cliffside event, enter the forest after 8PM

Also tweaks Linus's 1-heart event and Pierre's 6-heart event.
[/spoiler]

[center][b]GIFT TASTES[/b][/center]
[spoiler]
Jorts and Jean are cats and their gift tastes reflect that, so their loves are about what you'd expect. They are pro-union and hate Joja products. This is to say I don't remember all the specifics and recommend Lookup Anything if you want more details. :D

Movies:
Jorts loves or likes all films.
Jean loves Natural Wonders, dislikes It Howls In The Rain, and likes all others.
 
For concessions, Jorts loves nachos and salmon burger, likes truffle popcorn and salted peanuts, and dislikes the rest (it's bad for cats).
Jean loves licorice (to play with, mostly) and salmon burger, likes truffle popcorn and salted peanuts, and dislikes the rest.
[/spoiler]

[b][center]SCHEDULE[/center][/b]
[spoiler]
Mon AM: outside the Jojamart
Mon PM: Lewis's Manor/the Community Center if it's complete
Tues AM: inside the Museum
Tues PM: outside the Jojamart
Wed AM: George and Evelyn's House
Wed PM: outside the Saloon
Thurs AM: the large tree in Cindersap Forest
Thurs PM: at the bench outside the Saloon
Fri AM: inside the Museum
Fri PM: inside the Saloon
Sat AM: by the mountain lake
Sat PM: at the playground
Sun AM: south of the Museum
Sun PM: by the fountain
Sun late PM: outside Jodi's house

During rainy days, they stay indoors at the Adventurer's Guild.
They visit Ridgeside (if installed) on the 9th and 23rd.
[/spoiler]

SVE: [b]Is this compatible with SVE[/b]? Uhh, probably. Festival placements take into account SVE's unique maps, but it hasn't been fully tested with SVE and it's possible something goes sideways if something on the vanilla maps or events messes with them.  The union events include Clara/Martin if installed.  Glymr has thoughtfully done [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18324]a compat patch[/url] for the mountain map to remove the plank. Aerinanxiety has made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23596]a compatibility patch[/url] for some festival positions.

Rmmods has made an adorable [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/488410]Jorts and Jean portrait mod[/url] available on Naver!

﻿﻿﻿[b][center]REGARDING BUGS[/center][/b]
If you find a bug, the best way to let me know is to ping me in Discord (tiakall#4802, I can be found in the Stardew Valley discord and some other SDV-related ones) since I often forget to check comments. Please note:
[list]
[*][b]If you are reporting an overlap in festival placement[/b]: I use Hime's [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Custom_NPC_Tiles][/url][url=https://stardewmodding.wiki/wiki/Custom_NPC_Tiles]Custom NPC Tiles[/url]﻿﻿ as well as my own playthroughs to avoid overlaps. If an NPC you are using is not listed there, please encourage the mod creator to add them so we can all avoid future incompatibilities (or add them yourself if you're comfortable with festival coordinates!) I likely will not move any festival placements without this information. (Though should you be inclined, it is pretty easy to [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki/wiki/Tutorial:_How_to_edit_a_custom_NPC_festival_position_for_personal_use]adjust them yourself[/url]﻿.)
[*][b]If it's a compatibility issue with SVE[/b]: I'll take a look at it, but SVE compatibility is not my priority over adding new features.
[/list]
[b][center]ABOUT DONATION POINTS[/center][/b]
I normally don't enable DP on my mods because I personally don't like monetizing my hobbies, but for this one DP is turned on because any DP earned will be donated to the [url=https://ufw.org/]United Farm Workers[/url]﻿ nonprofit.  They are a union-like organization fighting for rights for farm workers, who are often excluded from basic protections, such as being guaranteed overtime pay.  This is a cause Jorts and his human are passionate about and I think it's what he'd do. :)

[b][center]AI?[/center][center]﻿[/center][/b][center]﻿[b][i]absolutely the fuck not.[/i][/b] I do not permit ANY use of AI-generated content.[/center]
